masteryZone.q: Which of the following is an amphoteric oxide?
masteryZone.sol: Al₂O₃ reacts with both acids and bases to produce salt and water.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Copper displaces iron from iron sulfate solution.
masteryZone.sol: False. Copper is less reactive than iron and cannot displace it.

masteryZone.q: The only liquid non-metal at room temperature is ________.
masteryZone.sol: Bromine is the only non-metal liquid at room temperature.

masteryZone.q: Which ore is concentrated by the froth floatation method?
masteryZone.sol: Sulfide ores like Galena (PbS) are concentrated by froth floatation.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Roasting is used to heat carbonate ores in limited air.
masteryZone.sol: False. Calcination is used for carbonate ores; Roasting is for sulfide ores in excess air.

masteryZone.q: German Silver contains what percentage of silver?
masteryZone.sol: German Silver has 0% silver; it contains Copper, Zinc, and Nickel.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Galvanization uses a layer of zinc to protect iron.
masteryZone.sol: True. A thin coat of zinc prevents iron from contacting oxygen and moisture.
